title: Draft: Amend some protocol field filter names to avoid hyphen (minus)
description:
Avoid names that start with a digit and use a minus.

Fixes #19493.

commits_data.message:
proto: Add another field name check

Error out if we have a string in the protocol filter name
that stars with digit and contains a minus.

This avoids ambiguities with the symbol for subtraction.
